deploy-bot: Scheduling migration '2026_06_user_flags_stream' for prod during 01:30-02:15 UTC. Runtime pin r12.4. Canary 1% for 12m then holdpoint. Auto-pause on error_rate>2 or replica_lag>4s.
anya: TL;DR: adding nullable jsonb `flags` to users, then streaming populate from events store. Backfill uses `user_flags_streamer --workers=6 --batch=250`. No default to avoid rewrite.
kevin: ops ask: table is hot in our EU region evenings; window chosen low-risk but still want hard hold at +20m.
sam: rollback checklist?
marta: rollback: 1) stop streamer; 2) flip FF `user_flags_read`->false; 3) if corrupted rows detected, run `user_flags_repair --snapshot` (manual). Also we can revert by running a compacting pass to null out new flags if needed.
anya: migration steps: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN flags jsonb; run streamer; run lightweight validation queries comparing counts; then add index if safe. Example validation: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE flags IS NOT NULL;` compare to expected.
kevin: preflight request: check replica_lag < 800ms and open_tx < 4. deploy-bot can gate.
deploy-bot: Preflight scheduled at 01:20 UTC. Will abort if replica_lag >= 800ms or open_tx > 4.
sam: monitoring: watch p95 write latency, replica lag, and consumer error rates. If p95 write >180ms or replica lag >2s for >2m, pause.
marta: assign approver: @marta primary, @kevin backup. I'll be live in window.
anya: release notes: "Add nullable flags jsonb to users for feature toggles, populated by streaming backfill. Safe rollback via feature flag. Backfill runs in small batches to reduce hot partitions." Link: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/2026-06-user-flags
opsbot: @marta set as approver for 01:30-02:15 UTC. Pager: primary marta, secondary sam.
kevin: small ops nit: add a temporary Datadog monitor `migration:user_flags_stream` watching `pg_locks`, `replica_lag`, and write latency; tag with migration id.
anya: can we add a holdpoint at +12m (after canary) and +35m (before index)? Both require explicit approval to proceed.
sam: yes — deploy-bot will post canary-check at +12m and +35m. +35m is manual hold.
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: schema-lint ✓, dry-run ✓, runtime-pin r12.4 ✓. Proceed unless a hold requested.
anya: final: I'll post a readiness update 30m before. Thanks all.
